name: Single box (app + DB)
description: The classic small deployment: one server running the application and its database on the same machine — no separate DB node. App and DB share the box's CPU and RAM.
notes: Raise the user count until it turns red, then apply the 'move the database onto its own host' fix and watch capacity jump — that split is the whole point of separating tiers. Or bump dbBufferGB to see the box flip from CPU-bound to RAM-bound.
